prompt_text: Which residential pest control companies are the most reputable in the Northeast US (New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania)?
response_text:
When seeking reputable residential pest control services in the Northeast U.S., particularly in New York, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania, consider the following companies:

**[Viking Pest Control](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Viking+Pest+Control%2C+Basking+Ridge%2C+NJ?utm_source=openai)**
_Basking Ridge, NJ_
With over 45 years of experience, Viking offers eco-friendly, science-backed treatments across NJ, PA, DE, and MD. They provide comprehensive residential protection plans and are recognized by Forbes Home and Better Homes & Gardens.

**[Cooper Pest Solutions](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Cooper+Pest+Solutions%2C+Lawrenceville%2C+NJ?utm_source=openai)**
_Lawrenceville, NJ_
Serving NJ and PA since 1955, Cooper offers one-time services and year-round prevention plans. Their licensed experts focus on long-term solutions and customer satisfaction.

**[Rest Easy Pest Control](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Rest+Easy+Pest+Control%2C+New+York%2C+NY?utm_source=openai)**
_New York, NY_
Operating since 2012, Rest Easy serves over 921 communities across NY, NJ, and PA. They offer same-day service and have garnered over 2,500 positive Google reviews.

**[Horizon Pest Control](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Horizon+Pest+Control%2C+Midland+Park%2C+NJ?utm_source=openai)**
_Midland Park, NJ_
Family-owned since 1970, Horizon provides residential pest control in NJ and NY. They emphasize comprehensive, reliable service with a commitment to customer satisfaction.

**[BHB Pest Elimination](https://www.google.com/maps/search/BHB+Pest+Elimination%2C+New+York%2C+NY?utm_source=openai)**
_New York, NY_
Family-run since 1969, BHB offers services in NYC and Northern NJ. They conduct thorough inspections and use kid- and pet-friendly treatments, backed by QualityPro accreditation.

**[Green Pest Solutions](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Green+Pest+Solutions%2C+West+Chester%2C+PA?utm_source=openai)**
_West Chester, PA_
As the largest locally owned pest control company in the PA, NJ, and DE tri-state area, Green Pest Solutions emphasizes integrated pest management and boasts a 4.9-star average rating from over 29,000 customer reviews.

**[Western Pest Services](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Western+Pest+Services%2C+Parsippany-Troy+Hills%2C+NJ?utm_source=openai)**
_Parsippany-Troy Hills, NJ_
Established in 1928, Western offers services across NJ, NY, CT, PA, and DE. They provide both residential and commercial pest control solutions with a longstanding reputation.

**[All Platinum Pest Control](https://www.google.com/maps/search/All+Platinum+Pest+Control%2C+Staten+Island%2C+NY?utm_source=openai)**
_Staten Island, NY_
Family-owned and operated, All Platinum serves the entire Tri-state area, including NY, NJ, CT, and PA. They offer same-day service with no contracts and have over 1,200 five-star reviews.

When selecting a pest control provider, consider factors such as the company's experience, range of services, customer reviews, and commitment to eco-friendly practices. It's advisable to contact multiple providers to discuss your specific needs and obtain quotes before making a decision.
